# Socialbrite

> > Socialbrite empowers nonprofits and mission-driven organizations with strategic social media marketing and fundraising solutions.

Socialbrite is a specialized social media marketing agency focused on serving nonprofits and NGOs. With operations across major cities including New York, San Francisco, Boston, and London, the organization helps cause-driven organizations amplify their mission through strategic social media campaigns and digital fundraising initiatives.
